offering_description.value: Skillsoft sells online learning software and course libraries to employers, government agencies, and individual learners. It develops and licenses course content and delivers training through its online platforms, live classes, and coaching.

primary_products.value: enterprise learning software; digital course libraries; interactive coding courses; skills assessments

primary_services.value: instructor-led IT training; certification preparation; leadership coaching

customer_segment.value: B2B: Employers and private institutions buying training for their workforce; B2C: Individuals learning to code or developing professional skills; B2G: Government agencies buying workforce training for public employees

end_markets.value: corporate learning and development; public-sector workforce training; professional IT certification; consumer coding education

revenue_model.value: subscription: Employer and individual access to learning platforms, courses, and assessments; service fees: Live course enrollment, private group training, and coaching

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Hosts internally developed and licensed course content for organizations and individual learners; service provider: Engages instructors and coaches to train employees, public-sector staff, and individuals

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Leadership, business skills, compliance, coding, IT certification, and coaching

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving employers and government agencies; online: Self-service subscriptions and course enrollment through company websites; partners / resellers: Learning technology partners and training resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Learner and employee data handling subject to GDPR and applicable privacy laws

notes: Current ownership of the standalone instructor-led IT training business is uncertain.
